confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are ballpark figures from crowdsourced and modelled sources, several of which are dated, mix Marmaris with nearby resorts, and disagree by 30-50%. Cocktail and wine are weaker: cocktail is set from the beer relationship and wine from tourist-area glass prices elsewhere in Turkey. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season with no accommodation search performed, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Turkey is classed as Middle East in this schema. Restaurant and drink prices are benchmarked to Marmaris listings and to comparable Aegean and Mediterranean Turkish resorts (Bodrum, Fethiye, Alanya), with tourist-zone pricing used rather than backstreet or local-only prices. Accommodation reflects Marmaris summer resort pricing judged from general knowledge.
